decision_conditions: The proposed single-storey rear extension, by reason of its excessive footprint, depth and ad hoc design relative to the appearance of the host dwellinghouse, forms an incongruous, insubordinate design element failing to respect the architectural integrity of the host property, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the London Borough of Harrow’s Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).

The proposal, by reasons of the proposed flat with an undersized gross internal floor area, and the poor quality outlook and private outdoor amenity space for the existing ground floor flat at the host property, results in poor quality residential amenity for existing and future occupiers of the property, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the London Borough of Harrow’s Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).

The proposed rear extension, by reason of its excessive depth, height and ad hoc design, would result in an incongruous design element along the common boundary with No. 33 Roxeth Green Avenue, causing harm via visual overbearing and dominance, whilst also restricting the future development potential of this property. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the London Borough of Harrow’s Residential Design Guide Supplementary Planning Document (2010).

Insufficient information has been provided in support of the application to demonstrate acceptable biodiversity effects and that mandatory Biodiversity Net Gain requirements for the development would be achieved, contrary to Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (inserted by the Environment Act 2021), the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM21 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).

Insufficient flood mitigation is proposed or otherwise provided with the application to demonstrate the development would function safely for future occupiers, nor to prove it would not exacerbate adverse flooding effects on the surrounding environment, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy SI 12 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).
description: Single storey side to rear extension to create an additional flat (1 x 1 bed); separate amenity space; bin / cycle storage
subdivision_of_building: Ground floor flat rear extension and side extension for access.

phasing_details.phase_detail: Subject to planning approval ,the client aims to start the construction  in Feb 2025 and to complete the work by Aug.2025.
